The '''Gesaril system''' contained [[Gesaril]], a planet the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] had quarantined. It was located in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Intrepid (Munifex-class)|''Intrepid'']] orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Gesaril under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dulrain]] serving a dual purpose: to enforce the quarantine on Gesaril, and to guard the prison that was located on a nearby [[Asteroid/Legends|ateroid]].<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>
